docstring:
Returns the combined height of two objects in meters, given their bounding boxes.

Args:
    image (image): Image of the scene.
    bbox1 (list): A bounding box [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] containing object1.
    bbox2 (list): A bounding box [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] containing object2.

Returns:
    float: Combined height of the two objects in meters.

Returns the width of an object in meters, given its bounding box.

Args:
    image (image): Image of the scene.
    bbox (list): A bounding box [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] containing the object.

Returns:
    float: Width of the object in meters.

Counts the number of objects matching a description in the image.

Args:
    image (image): Image of the scene.
    object_prompt (string): Description of the objects to count.

Returns:
    int: Number of objects matching the description.

Returns the bounding box of the object that is closer in depth among two objects.

Args:
    image (image): Image of the scene.
    bbox1 (list): A bounding box [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] containing object1.
    bbox2 (list): A bounding box [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] containing object2.

Returns:
    list: The bounding box [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] of the object that is closer in depth.
